about: Spec 037 FR-001 golden-set labels for channel-logs-2026-10.json, hand-kept. Each post lists every code the deterministic checks should return on it (see integrity/codes.ts for the catalogue). `code@Tn` = expected once task Tn extends a check that already exists (the code is implemented, this case is not yet): todo while it does not fire; drop the marker when it does. `clean: true` = no error-level finding (warnings only if listed). Owner decisions 2026-10-15 applied: hashtags off in all three DEV channels (every post with a hashtag expects hashtag_while_off), address «ви» everywhere (a ти-form post expects address_mixed: error when both forms are in one post, warning otherwise). Leads: 57 posts open bold; 31 leads are over 140 chars (4 over 220).
